Ellie, named in-game as Dead Fisher, was a fisher who died on the Ravaged Beach in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Ellie's corpse is south of the  Overgrown Ruins X: 276 Y: 298. The party can commune with her corpse using  Speak with Dead, which reveals that intellect devourers likely killed her after the Nautiloid crash.

Speak with Dead

  • Who are you?
    • Dead Fisher
      Ellie... fisherwoman... Elturel...
      • Elturel? Are we close to the city?
        • Dead Fisher
          No... upriver... too far...
  • How did you die?
    • Dead Fisher
      Chased elf... brains chased me...
